headline: President Bush hands out certain powers and duties under the Trade Act of 2002 to other federal officials.
what_it_does: This order passes certain powers and tasks that the Trade Act of 2002 gave the President to other parts of the federal government. The title does not say which officials or agencies get these duties or which specific powers are involved. No summary was provided, so the details are unclear.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and officials that handle trade
who_it_affects.how: They are given certain powers and jobs under the Trade Act of 2002 that would otherwise rest with the President.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 19, 2002; exact effective date not stated in the source material.
